node.text: Years after Majin Buu’s defeat, Earth has returned to peace. But when Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens, that peace is shattered. Drawn to Earth by rumors of the Saiyan who defeated Frieza, Beerus seeks to challenge Goku with a power capable of destroying entire planets. Now, Goku and his allies must stand against Beerus in a battle that will shake the universe.
